__baseline_prompt__.text: A photographic scene, an independently chosen production-side view of fictional idol performers during the work of making an idol-group record. In a small professional recording booth, a fictional 24-year-old female lead vocalist is starting a harmony pickup while her two bandmates help her catch the entrance through the control-room glass. The supplied reference portrait guides her face and hair appearance: a dark chin-length bob, fine parted wispy bangs, large dark rounded eyes, softly tapered cheeks, a small straight nose and naturally full pink lips. Her identity and circumstances belong to this fictional scene. The singer occupies the right foreground, shown from the waist up in a plain dove-gray sleeveless rehearsal top, wearing over-ear studio headphones. One hand lightly cups the nearest headphone earcup, with the wrist continuing into a relaxed raised forearm and elbow; her other hand rests on the lower edge of a lyric stand. Her mouth is slightly open toward the condenser microphone at frame left. Its round pop filter sits just left of her mouth, leaving her eyes, nose and both cheeks readable. Her head follows the microphone while her eyes lift toward her bandmate's counting hand beyond the glass, a small absorbed smile beginning at one corner of her lips. The supporting attraction is warm, unforced and particular to her concentration. Through the large window filling the left middle distance, one bandmate leans toward the glass with two fingers raised in a clear pickup count; the second sits beside her holding the same color-marked lyric pages. A producer at the console presses a talkback button and watches the vocalist. Three differently colored vocal-track lanes on the session screen and the shared marked lyric pages reinforce that this is a group recording session. The separation between booth and control room remains spatially clear, and the singer's gaze and the raised counting hand form the carrying diagonal of the frame. Horizontal 3:2 observational music-documentary photography from a position inside the booth, slightly to the singer's front right, with a natural 50 mm perspective and moderate depth of field. Preserve crisp facial detail and enough focus across the window to read the counting gesture and the producer's action. Soft warm booth light models her cheeks and the sheen of her dark bob, balanced by cooler monitor light behind the glass; restrained color, natural skin texture, tangible microphone mesh and lightly worn acoustic panels.
